templates.title: MongoDB Dump Scheduler (Edge)
templates.description: Scheduled, encrypted mongodump backups shipped to S3-compatible storage, with retention, restore verification and optional central management via a Portal.
templates.note: The web UI listens on the mapped host port (default 9999) once the container is healthy; check /health. The LiteDB config, AES key and backup files persist in a single named volume. All Portal, S3/MinIO and notification variables are optional — leave them blank to run this Edge standalone.

env.name: MDBDR_TAG
env.label: Image tag
env.description: macoev/mdbdr tag to deploy, e.g. master or a version tag.

env.name: MDBDR_PORT
env.label: Host port
env.description: Host port published for the Edge web UI.

env.name: PORTAL_BASE_URL
env.label: Portal base URL
env.description: Optional. URL of a MongoDumpScheduler Portal to register this Edge with, e.g. https://portal.mydomain.com.

env.name: PORTAL_API_KEY
env.label: Portal API key
env.description: Optional. API key issued by the Portal after registering this Edge.

env.name: PORTAL_EDGE_NAME
env.label: Portal edge name
env.description: Optional. Friendly name for this Edge shown in the Portal.

env.name: PORTAL_AUTHORITY
env.label: Portal OIDC authority
env.description: Optional. Needed only for Portal machine-to-machine authentication.

env.name: PORTAL_CLIENT_ID
env.label: Portal OIDC client ID
env.description: Optional. Needed only for Portal machine-to-machine authentication.

env.name: PORTAL_CLIENT_SECRET
env.label: Portal OIDC client secret
env.description: Optional. Needed only for Portal machine-to-machine authentication.

env.name: MINIO_ENDPOINT
env.label: S3/MinIO endpoint
env.description: Optional. S3-compatible endpoint backups are uploaded to.

env.name: MINIO_ACCESSKEY
env.label: S3/MinIO access key
env.description: Optional.

env.name: MINIO_SECRETKEY
env.label: S3/MinIO secret key
env.description: Optional.

env.name: MINIO_DEFAULT_BUCKETNAME
env.label: S3/MinIO bucket
env.description: Optional.

env.name: MINIO_REGION
env.label: S3/MinIO region
env.description: Optional.

env.name: NOTIFICATIONS_ENABLED
env.label: Enable webhook notifications
env.description: Optional. true or false — notifies only on failures, never on success.

env.name: NOTIFICATIONS_WEBHOOK_URL
env.label: Notification webhook URL
env.description: Optional. Slack/Discord-compatible webhook URL.

templates.title: MongoDB Dump Scheduler (Portal)
templates.description: Central orchestrator for MongoDumpScheduler Edge nodes: registration, heartbeats, live SignalR status and log aggregation from one dashboard.
templates.note: Requires an OpenID Connect provider for human sign-in — the Authority, Client ID and Client Secret fields are required and the deploy fails without them. The Authority must end with a trailing slash (e.g. https://idp.example.com/). The LiteDB database persists in a named volume. Once running, point each Edge's Portal:BaseUrl at this instance.

env.name: MDBDR_PORTAL_TAG
env.label: Image tag
env.description: macoev/mdbdr-portal tag to deploy, e.g. master or a version tag.

env.name: MDBDR_PORTAL_PORT
env.label: Host port
env.description: Host port published for the Portal web UI.

env.name: OIDC_AUTHORITY
env.label: OIDC authority
env.description: Required. Must end with a trailing slash, e.g. https://idp.example.com/.

env.name: OIDC_CLIENT_ID
env.label: OIDC client ID
env.description: Required. Client ID registered with your identity provider for the Portal.

env.name: OIDC_CLIENT_SECRET
env.label: OIDC client secret
env.description: Required. Client secret registered with your identity provider for the Portal.

env.name: SEQ_SERVER_URL
env.label: Seq server URL
env.description: Optional. Ships the Portal's own logs to a Seq server; empty disables the sink entirely.

env.name: SEQ_API_KEY
env.label: Seq API key
env.description: Optional. Only used when a Seq server URL is set.
